_comment: The SHAPE of the price catalogue, with deliberately fake figures.
The real catalogue is commercially confidential and never enters this repository.
Copy this to $DATA_ROOT/agents/outbound/data/pricing.json and put the real list in it.
Every figure here is a round number so that nobody can mistake it for a price.
`enterprise_grade` gates whether the Standard support line may attach at all — it does
not decide whether it does. That is the caller's choice per account, because the same
quorum is sold with and without support and only the account says which.

defence_grade_quorum.composition: 3x appliance, rubidium plus, plus rack kit

portable.composition: 1x mini appliance, full module, per vehicle
